not_covered.reason: Unused per-player data left from early development. Only Chrono shield cooldowns write it, which commands cannot trigger. Boss defeat and portal stabilization are recorded in chronodawn_global_state, which is checked.
Created only when a boss-room structure generates; the test's forceloaded area has none, and placing one by command does not register its protected area.
Written by boss-room structure spawning, which the test does not trigger.
The setup kills its boss so the kill path runs; a living boss would attack the test player and leave the forceloaded area.
